meta.themes: Cyber Defense Models, Agent Platforms, Robotics Reasoning, Capital & Compute

news.title: Google expanded Gemini and NotebookLM programs for educators and scaled AI literacy training
news.summary: Google outlined new Gemini and NotebookLM enhancements for classrooms, broader Google Cloud offerings for academia, NEET mock exams in Gemini, Moodle integrations, and a nationwide AI educator series launching in partnership with ISTE+ASCD.

news.title: Microsoft brought partner business apps into Microsoft 365 Copilot chat via the Agent Store
news.summary: Microsoft said Copilot agents now surface Adobe Express, Figma, Optimizely, Dynamics 365, and other partner workflows inside chat so teams can execute work without switching apps, with MCP Apps called out for custom integrations.

news.title: OpenAI scaled Trusted Access for Cyber with GPT‑5.4‑Cyber for vetted defenders
news.summary: OpenAI expanded tiered verification for cybersecurity professionals, introducing GPT‑5.4‑Cyber tuned for defensive workloads with tighter refusal boundaries suitable only for audited programs alongside existing grant support.

news.title: Google DeepMind shipped Gemini Robotics‑ER 1.6 with stronger embodied reasoning
news.summary: The upgrade emphasizes spatial logic, multi-view understanding, task planning, success detection, and instrument reading informed by Boston Dynamics collaboration, positioning it as DeepMind’s safest robotics-first model to date.

news.title: NVIDIA released open Ising quantum AI models for calibration and error correction
news.summary: NVIDIA pitched Ising as the first open family tuned for quantum processor calibration and decoding workloads, partnering with labs including Lawrence Berkeley and the U.K. National Physical Laboratory to accelerate useful quantum systems.

news.title: Anthropic confirmed U.S. government briefings on Claude Mythos Preview capabilities
news.summary: Co-founder Jack Clark told Semafor attendees Anthropic walked officials through Mythos amid heightened cybersecurity stakes, framing cooperation as necessary even while the company contests Pentagon contracting restrictions in court.

news.title: OpenAI upgraded the Agents SDK with harness tools, sandbox execution, and MCP-ready primitives
news.summary: The release adds filesystem and shell workflows, MCP integration, AGENTS.md guidance, hosted sandboxes via providers such as Modal and Runloop, and broader orchestration aimed at production agent stacks priced on standard API usage.

news.title: Cadence and Nvidia partnered to fuse physics simulation with Nvidia robot training stacks
news.summary: At CadenceLIVE the CEOs described integrating Cadence physics engines with Nvidia simulation environments so robotics teams can generate higher-fidelity synthetic training data and shorten iteration loops versus real-world collection alone.

news.title: Reuters Breakingviews questioned China’s race to monetize ultra-cheap AI tokens
news.summary: Commentary tracked surging domestic token consumption and new official terminology while warning token commodity strategies could collide with limits on frontier compute and chip access versus U.S. hyperscaler leads.

news.title: Reuters tied an AI mega-deal wave to lobbying shifts and blockbuster lab financings
news.summary: Reporting charted fresh mega-round funding totals for OpenAI and Anthropic alongside revived M&A appetite, spotlighting Anthropic’s parallel outreach to policymakers while navigating Defense Department blacklist fallout.

news.title: OpenAI broadened Codex with background Mac agents, Atlas browser embedding, and plugin surge
news.summary: The Codex desktop refresh targets more than coding with parallel computer-use tasks, Atlas-powered in-app browsing, image iteration via gpt-image-1.5, expanded automation hooks, and enterprise pay-as-you-go pricing experiments.

news.title: OpenAI introduced GPT‑Rosalind previews tailored to life sciences discovery workflows
news.summary: OpenAI pitched Rosalind as the first specialized series for biology and translational medicine with richer scientific tooling, trusted-access rollout, Codex plugin connectivity, and collaborations spanning major biopharma and research institutes.
